lines.text: Every morning at 6, Tony reads the local news on the radio.
lines.pt: Toda manhã, às 6, o Tony lê as notícias locais na rádio.

lines.text: Good morning, Orlando! Big news today. It is said that a famous actor has bought the bakery on Pine Street.

lines.text: He is believed to be in town this week, and the bakery is thought to be closing soon.

lines.text: By 7 AM, there was a line of fans outside the bakery. Rosa called Tony.

lines.text: Tony, who told you that?

lines.text: Rumor has it he was seen there on Monday. It's been reported online, too.

lines.text: Seen doing what, exactly?

lines.text: He was seen standing outside the bakery. In sunglasses. Very suspicious.

lines.text: The next morning, Tony had to read a correction.

lines.text: Update: the actor did not buy the bakery. Apparently, he just had his bike fixed at the shop next door.
lines.pt: Atualização: o ator não comprou a padaria. Pelo jeito, ele só mandou consertar a bicicleta na loja do lado.

lines.text: But the bakery is said to have sold four hundred croissants yesterday.

grammar.title: Como funciona: a passiva da notícia (e do boato)
rows: It is said that he's rich.
It is believed that she's in town.
Acredita-se que ela está na cidade.
He is said to be rich.
Dizem que ele é rico. (sujeito = ele)
She is thought to be in Miami.
Acham que ela está em Miami.
The bakery is said to have sold 400 croissants.
Dizem que a padaria vendeu 400 croissants.
B1: The bakery was built in 1950.
A padaria foi construída em 1950. (passiva simples)
grammar.tip: No B1 você aprendeu a passiva simples (It was built in 1950). Agora é a passiva da NOTÍCIA: contar o que "dizem" sem dizer quem. Dois jeitos: It is said THAT + frase, ou Pessoa + is said TO + verbo. Falando do agora: to be (He is said to be rich). Falando do passado: to have + particípio (The bakery is said to have sold…). E é sempre said, believed, thought, com cara de particípio: It is say that ❌.

gossips.title: The Chef in 204

lines.text: Jenny was coming home from her night shift when Tony stopped her in the lobby.
lines.pt: A Jenny estava chegando do plantão noturno quando o Tony parou ela no saguão.

lines.text: Jenny, you know the new guy in 204, the chef? He **is said to be** the President's personal cook.
lines.pt: Jenny, sabe o cara novo do 204, o chef? Dizem que ele é o cozinheiro particular do Presidente.

lines.text: The President? Tony, it's 7 AM. Who told you that?
lines.pt: O Presidente? Tony, são 7 da manhã. Quem te falou isso?

lines.text: His mail. I didn't open it! But there was a letter from 'the Office of the President.'
lines.pt: A correspondência dele. Eu não abri! Mas tinha uma carta do "Gabinete do Presidente".

lines.text: So you **practically** read his mail.
lines.pt: Então você praticamente leu a correspondência dele.

lines.text: I glanced at it. Big difference. It's also believed that he's cooked for three kings.
lines.pt: Eu dei uma olhadinha. É bem diferente. Também acreditam que ele já cozinhou pra três reis.

lines.text: Three kings. Sure. Have you thought about just asking him?
lines.pt: Três reis. Claro. Já pensou em simplesmente perguntar pra ele?

lines.text: And ruin the mystery? No. I'm going to **look into** it myself.
lines.pt: E estragar o mistério? Não. Eu mesmo vou investigar.

lines.text: That evening, **out of nowhere**, the chef knocked on Tony's door, holding a pie.
lines.pt: Naquela noite, do nada, o chef bateu na porta do Tony, segurando uma torta.

lines.text: He explained that he cooks for the president of the Orlando Chess Club. Every Friday.
lines.pt: Ele explicou que cozinha pro presidente do Clube de Xadrez de Orlando. Toda sexta.

lines.text: Tony was disappointed. Then he tasted the pie.
lines.pt: O Tony ficou decepcionado. Aí ele provou a torta.

lines.text: Well, **you never know**. Maybe the chess club has kings, too.
lines.pt: Bom, nunca se sabe. Vai ver o clube de xadrez também tem reis.

lines.text: Last Saturday, a shark was reported in the Sunset Building pool.
lines.pt: No sábado passado, foi noticiado um tubarão na piscina do Sunset Building.

lines.text: Naturally, Tony was the first to hear about it. By Sunday morning, it was on the radio.

gossips.title: The Pop Star's Car

lines.text: Carlos, why are there twenty teenagers outside your garage?

lines.text: Because of that pink convertible. It is said to belong to Kaylee Moon.
lines.pt: Por causa daquele conversível rosa. Dizem que ele é da Kaylee Moon.

lines.text: The pop star? Who's saying that?
lines.pt: A cantora pop? Quem está dizendo isso?

lines.text: The whole internet. Someone posted a photo, and her name **came up** on every fan page.
lines.pt: A internet inteira. Alguém postou uma foto, e o nome dela apareceu em todas as páginas de fã.

lines.text: So she's believed to be in Orlando because of one photo?
lines.pt: Então acreditam que ela está em Orlando por causa de uma foto?

lines.text: I have no idea. The owner paid in cash and wore a hat.
lines.pt: Eu não faço ideia. O dono pagou em dinheiro e estava de chapéu.

lines.text: By noon, Carlos had sold forty T-shirts that said 'Kaylee's Mechanic.'
lines.pt: Ao meio-dia, o Carlos já tinha vendido quarenta camisetas escrito "Mecânico da Kaylee".

lines.text: Carlos! You can't sell T-shirts based on a rumor!
lines.pt: Carlos! Você não pode vender camiseta por causa de um boato!

lines.text: I'm not saying it's true. I'm just letting the fans **act as** detectives.
lines.pt: Eu não estou dizendo que é verdade. Só estou deixando os fãs bancarem os detetives.

lines.text: At five, the owner came back for the car. She was a small woman in her seventies.
lines.pt: Às cinco, a dona voltou pra buscar o carro. Era uma senhora baixinha, de uns setenta e poucos anos.

lines.text: She was Kaylee Moon's grandmother, and she was happy to **back up** the story. Sort of.
